summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Star Challenges feature (Iteration 9). All backend endpoints (11/11 tests) passed. Frontend UI working correctly with challenge banner, detail view, join toggle, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/challenges/current auto-creates and returns weekly challenge with title, description, start/end dates, entry_count, star_of_week
Backend: Challenge dates are Wednesday to Wednesday (7 days)
Backend: GET /api/challenges/{id}/entries returns entries for a specific challenge
Backend: GET /api/challenges/history returns past challenges with star_of_week
Backend: GET /api/challenges/nonexistent/entries returns 404
Backend: POST /api/stars with challenge_id tags performance to challenge
Backend: Challenge entries appear in GET /api/challenges/{id}/entries after submission
Backend: Star of the week is the top-voted entry in the challenge
Backend: POST /api/stars without challenge_id works for free karaoke
Backend: Current challenge endpoint is idempotent (returns same challenge)
Backend: Health endpoint returns healthy
Frontend: Star feed page shows Weekly Challenge banner with gradient (orange->pink->purple)
Frontend: Challenge banner shows title ('Freestyle Friday'), description, entry count (3 entries), and chevron
Frontend: Clicking challenge banner navigates to challenge detail view
Frontend: Challenge detail shows 'THIS WEEK'S CHALLENGE' banner with days left (4 days left)
Frontend: Challenge detail shows 'Enter' button in header
Frontend: Challenge detail shows entries section with ranked entries (3 entries)
Frontend: Challenge detail shows 'STAR OF THE WEEK' section (TEST_StarOfWeekUser with 1 vote)
Frontend: Challenge detail shows 'PAST CHALLENGES' section (Movie Soundtracks, R&B Grooves)
Frontend: Back button from challenge detail returns to feed
Frontend: Karaoke view shows challenge join toggle when a challenge exists
Frontend: Challenge join toggle text includes challenge title ('Join this week: Freestyle Friday')
Frontend: Toggle changes to 'Entering: Freestyle Friday' when active
Frontend: Submit button text changes to 'Submit to Challenge!' when challenge is joined (verified in code)
Frontend: 'Sing Now' still works for free karaoke (no challenge tag)
Frontend: No horizontal overflow on Star feed at 375px mobile viewport
Frontend: No horizontal overflow on Challenge detail at 375px mobile viewport
test_credentials: No authentication required - app is open access
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test challenge entries during backend testing (TEST_ChallengeUser, TEST_EntryCheckUser, TEST_StarOfWeekUser, TEST_FreeKaraokeUser)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 added Star Challenges feature. Weekly challenges auto-rotate based on CHALLENGE_THEMES array (12 themes). Current challenge is 'Freestyle Friday' (week 69). Challenge dates are Wednesday to Wednesday. Backend endpoints: GET /api/challenges/current (auto-creates), GET /api/challenges/{id}/entries, GET /api/challenges/history.
